result.planSummary: Implemented Story 0 foundation support for the Session Context Store by adding canonical record and error vocabularies, deterministic id/fingerprint and target-key helpers, reusable test fixtures and temp-store scaffolding, and repo verification/test scripts with the required foundation coverage.

changedFiles.reason: Added the Story 0 verification/test script contract: test, red-verify, verify, green-verify, verify-all, test:integration, and guard:no-test-changes.
Expanded TypeScript coverage to include the new test files.
Added a small test runner helper so unit and integration scripts can discover TypeScript tests and gracefully handle the current no-integration-tests state.
Added the canonical steward error codes, issue shape, result type, and shared result helpers.
Added the canonical Session Context Store record vocabulary, schema constants, and pure thread/root-index initialization helpers.
Added deterministic content fingerprinting, stable-id helpers, source-range helpers, generated id helpers, and canonical target-session key derivation.
Added reusable canonical record builders, PI-shaped fixture builders, snapshot helpers, and shared test timestamps for downstream stories.
Added isolated temp project/store helpers for future filesystem-backed store and service tests.
Added the required Story 0 foundation tests covering deterministic helper behavior and schema-version/thread-initialization defaults.

findingsFixed: Removed duplicate object-property patterns in fixture builders so the new foundation modules typecheck cleanly under strict NodeNext settings.
Tightened thread initialization defaults to omit undefined optional summary fields, keeping the schema/default assertions stable and future store initialization predictable.
Added a dedicated test discovery script so `verify-all` succeeds cleanly during the foundation-only phase before integration tests exist.
findingsSurfaced: PI fixture builders currently use lightweight local PI-shaped interfaces rather than importing exact upstream package types; that keeps Story 0 decoupled, but later PI mapper/import stories should confirm shape parity against the real package contracts.

result.recommendedNextStep: Implement Story 1 on top of these helpers by building `ThreadStore`/`FileThreadStore` and wiring thread initialization to reuse the shared record, key-derivation, and temp-store foundations.
